text: NO EFFECT: RAB5-labeled endosomal compartment area and RAB5 protein levels did not differ significantly between genotypes, including APOE4 vs APOE3. Class 5 because this measures endosome size and abundance, not pH.
description: Human isogenic APOE iPSC-derived astrocytes (day 44). Immunocytochemistry for RAB5 with S100β counterstain, quantified as % cell area (individual cells from three independent experiments). Western blot of RAB5 normalized to β-actin. Caveat: endosome morphology and abundance, not acidification.

provenance.excerpt: Endosomal compartments labeled with RAB5 did not show a significant difference in percentage of cell area between genotypes, and neither did RAB5 protein levels (Figures 4B, 4D, and 4E).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in RAB5+ endosome area or RAB5 protein) [NO EFFECT]

warnings: directness class 5: description should say why no class fits

perturbed.variable: APOE genotype (isogenic APOE4 vs APOE3 iPSC-astrocytes)

measured.variable: RAB5-positive endosomal area (% cell area) and RAB5 protein level by western blot
